from pathlib import Path

from html.parser import HTMLParser
import json,hashlib,csv,xlrd,re
ROOT=Path.cwd();R="reports/research/510300_bank_industry_constraint_source_probe_v1";OUT=ROOT/R
def load(name):return json.loads((OUT/name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
def save(name,obj):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),"已存在不覆盖："+str(p)
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
class Text(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self):super().__init__();self.body=False;self.parts=[];self.links=[]
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  if tag=="body":self.body=True
  if tag=="a":
   d=dict(attrs)
   if d.get("href"):self.links.append(d["href"])
 def handle_data(self,data):
  if self.body:self.parts.append(data)

table=load("官方正文_data_docId=1208453.json")["data"]
